items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Alfred Williams, you know Alfred Williams, he was the drummer.

ctx.x: He was on the sweet side. Yeah, he was sweet, straight, and he was on the right. Straight, sweet. Did they have an unusually good beat? A lot of people thought it was a wonderful dance band. It was a wonderful dance band.

Alfred Williams, you know Alfred Williams, he was the drummer. Rudolph was the drummer. And Roy, Roy Evans, he's dead long while. Well, he had some good men. Little Jim was like I told you, he was playing bass. Then after, Big Jim played, but Yank, he played at that time.
How does Yank play? I never know anything about him, never hear much of anybody mentioning him hard of that.
